title: Mehdi — Le diplômé sans carnet d'adresses
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive character, high quality render

character.name: Mehdi
character.description: Mehdi, a 27-year-old North African man, short curly black hair, clean shaven, slim fit grey suit slightly too new, backpack, bright intelligent eyes behind thin glasses

scenes.vo: Mehdi a le diplôme. Les compétences. La motivation. Tout, sauf une chose.
scenes.image_prompt: Mehdi in a slightly oversized new suit holding his degree folder outside a university, proud but alone, other graduates celebrating with families behind, autumn light
scenes.motion_prompt: He straightens his jacket, looks at the corporate towers in the distance, determined breath

scenes.vo: Entretien numéro douze. « Excellent profil. On vous rappellera. » Ils ne rappellent jamais.
scenes.image_prompt: Mehdi shaking hands at the end of a job interview with polite but distant recruiters in a glass meeting room, his hopeful face, corporate coldness
scenes.motion_prompt: Handshake, polite nods, the door closes on him in slow motion, his smile fades in the corridor

scenes.vo: Puis un jour, il comprend. Le poste qu'il visait ? Parti à un « fils de ». Le problème, ce n'est pas son CV. C'est son réseau.
scenes.image_prompt: Mehdi at a cafe seeing a LinkedIn post on his phone announcing someone else got the position, congratulation comments flooding, his reflection in the window pensive
scenes.motion_prompt: He scrolls the congratulations, looks up at his reflection in the cafe window, realization dawns

scenes.vo: Ses parents ne peuvent pas l'aider. Personne dans la famille ne connaît ce milieu. Le réseau, chez lui, ça ne s'hérite pas.
scenes.image_prompt: Warm family dinner in a modest home, his proud parents and siblings around couscous, Mehdi loved but carrying his worry alone, tender lighting
scenes.motion_prompt: His mother serves him with pride, he smiles at her tenderly, then his gaze drifts to the window

scenes.vo: Alors il décide de le construire lui-même. Une soirée networking Nour Meet. Puis deux. Puis cinq.
scenes.image_prompt: Mehdi at a warm restaurant networking dinner, listening intensely to experienced professionals, taking mental notes, engaged and alive, candlelight
scenes.motion_prompt: Animated conversation around the table, he asks a question, a senior professional turns to him with interest

scenes.vo: À la cinquième, il rencontre Karima. Directrice dans sa branche. Elle devient son mentor.
scenes.image_prompt: An elegant confident woman in her fifties exchanging contact with Mehdi at the dinner, genuine warmth, other guests around, golden atmosphere
scenes.motion_prompt: She hands him her card with an encouraging smile, he receives it with both hands, moved

scenes.vo: Trois mois plus tard : « Mehdi, une boîte cherche exactement ton profil. Je t'ai recommandé. » Cette fois, ils ont rappelé.
scenes.image_prompt: Mehdi in the street answering a phone call, his face exploding with joy, fist raised, passersby smiling, sunny Parisian street
scenes.motion_prompt: He listens, stops walking, punches the air with joy, spins around laughing

scenes.vo: Le réseau ne devrait pas être un privilège de naissance. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
